name: binary_task_suite_v2_16cells
evaluation_note: Held-out cases never enter RL training. Future transfer tests must freeze network weights and use fresh N100/S50/F50 statistics; no automatic evaluation.

operators.name: REVERSE5
operators.rule: Reverse abcde to edcba, zero extended to6 bits

operators.name: SORT5
operators.rule: Sort abcde ascending, zero extended to6 bits

operators.name: CONDITIONAL_REVERSE5
operators.rule: If a=0 copy abcde; if a=1 reverse abcde

operators.name: ONE_RUNS5
operators.rule: Number of maximal runs of ones in abcde

operators.name: TRANSITIONS5
operators.rule: Number of adjacent unequal pairs in abcde

operators.name: LOCAL_PARITIES5
operators.rule: [a XOR b,b XOR c,c XOR d,d XOR e,e XOR a]

operators.name: NOT5
operators.rule: Bitwise complement of abcde within5 bits

operators.name: PREFIX_PARITIES5
operators.rule: [a,a XOR b,a XOR b XOR c,...,a XOR b XOR c XOR d XOR e]

operators.name: SUFFIX_PARITIES5
operators.rule: [a XOR b XOR c XOR d XOR e,...,d XOR e,e]

operators.name: CRC6
operators.rule: Start register0; feed abcde MSB first; feedback=register bit5 XOR input; shift left masked63; XOR3 if feedback1

operators.name: HAMMING_DISTANCE_10101
operators.rule: Number of differing bits between abcde and10101

operators.name: LONGEST_ONE_RUN5
operators.rule: Length of longest contiguous run of ones

operators.name: RANDOM_LOOKUP_A
operators.rule: Fixed random6-bit lookup table generated with LOOKUP_SEED

operators.name: RANDOM_LOOKUP_B
operators.rule: Second fixed random6-bit lookup table generated with LOOKUP_SEED
